system.notes:
Three immortal nagas serve as the great oracles for the feathered serpent god, Oatali. These nagas reside in ancient, deadly temples hidden in the Tal-Yool jungle. Each naga’s scales are encrusted with gems that match the three places from which Oatali derives his power: The jungle (jade), the river (lapis lazuli), and the sun (rubies). A gem-encrusted, hooded cobra with a wise countenance. Delicate gold cuffs and ornaments dot the length of its coiled, 15-foot body.

AC 16, HP 57, ATK 3 bite +7 (2d8 + poison) and 1 spell +7, MV near (climb), S +4, D +1, C +3, I +2, W +4, Ch +4, AL L, LV 12

Poison. DC 15 CON or paralyzed 1d4 rounds.

Being (WIS Spell). DC 12. End all spells affecting one target in near.

Knowing (WIS Spell). DC 12. Learn the answer to a yes or no question.

Seeming (WIS Spell). DC 13. Focus. Create a convincing illusion within near up to the size of the naga.

Art by Matt Morrow, 2023
